key_patterns: ENCODING: src/types/database.ts is currently UTF-16LE with CRLF (from `supabase gen types > file` on Windows PowerShell); `file` misdetects it as C++ source. It must be rewritten as UTF-8. BOUNDARY: raw generator output runs from line 1 through the `} as const` that closes `export const Constants` (ends ~line 1455 in the UTF-8 view). Lines after that (`export type CourseStatus = ...` etc., ~1457-1475) are the HAND-APPENDED block to REMOVE. The raw generator output also legitimately includes helper types `Tables`, `TablesInsert`, `TablesUpdate`, `Enums`, `CompositeTypes` and `export const Constants` - KEEP those. Do NOT hand-edit any generated TYPE SHAPES. ALIASES: consumers import convenience aliases AND raw generator names (Json, Database, QuestionType, CourseStatus) all from '@/types/database'. The regen-safe pattern: keep database.ts raw, add a sibling barrel src/types/db.ts that does `export * from './database'` plus defines all convenience aliases derived from Database, then repoint every import site from '@/types/database' -> '@/types/db' (and './database' -> './db' in src/types/domain.ts). GENERATED ENUM NAMES in Database['public']['Enums']: account_status, content_status, course_status, course_visibility, enrollment_status, friendship_status, notification_type, question_type, room_member_status, user_role. NOTE: CompletionContext ('course'|'room') and PacVisibility ('members'|'educator_only'|'public') are NOT pg enums (generated as plain `string`), so they must remain explicit string-literal unions matching the app domain model (confirmed from git history commit 9f888d0 originals). ROW ALIASES all map to Tables (not Views): AnnouncementRow->announcements, AnswerRow->answers, AttemptRow->attempts, CommentRow->comments, CompletionRow->completions, CourseRow->courses, EnrollmentRow->enrollments, FriendshipRow->friendships, LessonRow->lessons, MedalRow->medals, MissionRow->missions, ModuleRow->modules, NotebookPageRow->notebook_pages, NotebookRow->notebooks, NotificationRow->notifications, ProfileRow->profiles, QuestionRow->questions, ReviewRow->reviews, RoomMemberRow->room_members, RoomRow->rooms, UserMedalRow->user_medals. GLOBAL_RANKING is a VIEW with all-nullable columns (user_id: string|null, etc.) - app's GlobalRankRow expects non-null; fix at the mapping boundary in src/features/rankings/api.ts, NOT by editing generated types.
